title: Risky Terraform setting (dbpublic) — review required
description: Infrastructure as code weakens a control: publicly_accessible = true (dbpublic). Public data stores, wildcard IAM, all-traffic rules, and disabled encryption or protection each expose the account. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms necessity or hardens it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of account scope.
